decisions.decision: T-251 is merged, so branch from current main, not tantra-walkthroughs. Remove every ruled-out vendor. (2) State every date relative to the weekly cohort (Wed to Fri, 11:00 America/New_York) and point to app/src/lib/cohort.ts. No literal dates. (3) Day 0 card 3: require an event description plus 5, 10, 15 and 30 minute reminders. (4) For each manual step, automate it or name an owner. DKIM is read by the agent through the Cloudflare API. WebinarGeek follows T-268. Settle every 'owner to confirm' item from the memories. The rest get a team owner by area (Ops: Nelbin, Delivery: Aquila, Infra: Ben) and a due date. (5) Title Case all headings. (6) Update the coverage.json notes and give each human-only entry an owner. Run the grep and probe-headings, commit and push to main, then mark H069 to H073 and X108 fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit SHA.
